title: Why Plucking Nose Hair Makes You Cry Instantly
caption:
One nose hair plucked, tears flooding. Sound familiar?
A guy spots one tiny nose hair in the mirror, plucks it with tweezers - and instantly bursts into cartoon tears.
It's the trigeminal nerve reflex: your nose is lined with a sensitive trigeminal nerve wired to your lacrimal (tear) glands, so one pluck fires a pain signal straight to the tear ducts. Always trim, never pluck.
Has one tiny nose hair ever turned you into a crying fountain?
Save this before your next mirror showdown and follow for more body science.
